# Security Policy

Thank you for your interest in keeping this project secure.
Please follow these instructions if you discover a vulnerability.

## Vulnerability Reporting

If you find a security issue, please submit a private report to:

**Email:** <alt.tyronejosee@gmail.com>
or use GitHub’s **Report a Vulnerability** option: [GitHub Security Advisories](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories)

Include the following information:

- Detailed description of the issue.
- Steps to reproduce it.
- Potential impact.
- Environment where it occurs (OS, software version, relevant dependencies).

## What Not to Do

- Do not post vulnerabilities in public issues or pull requests.
- Avoid sharing exploits publicly until a fix is available.

## Response Time

- We will confirm receipt of your report within 24–48 hours.
- We will attempt to provide a fix or patch as quickly as possible.
- You will be notified when the vulnerability has been resolved and is safe to disclose publicly.

## General Best Practices

- Keep your dependencies up to date.
- Do not share credentials or sensitive information in the repository.
- Review and follow GitHub’s security policies to keep your project secure.
